column2: The Dashboard will be refreshed additionally at 10:30 am daily, so please make sure to update the comment before the refresh starts
TA Weekly Note & TS Weekly Note
1. Ensure that the TAs/TSs are correctly listed and assigned to the right client.
2. If a TA/TS is missing, simply add the person to the list at least one day before WBR meeting
3. If a TA/TS left the company last week, just delete the row (at least one day before WBR meeting)
4. Only the list of TAs/TSs will be shown in the WBR dashboard for the selected week.
5. Check the week to ensure you are entering the comment on the right date.
6. Any duplicated TA/TS in the same week will cause the dashboard refresh to break.
